article.headline: New Orleans faces Denver, looks to break home skid
article.description: Denver Nuggets (6-4, ninth in the Western Conference) vs. New Orleans Pelicans (4-9, 12th in the Western Conference)
article.title: New Orleans faces Denver, looks to break home skid
article.linkText: New Orleans faces Denver, looks to break home skid
article.story: Denver Nuggets (6-4, ninth in the Western Conference) vs. New Orleans Pelicans (4-9, 12th in the Western Conference) New Orleans; Saturday, 7 p.m. EST LINE: Nuggets -11.5; over/under is 234.5 BOTTOM LINE: New Orleans looks to stop its three-game home skid with a win against Denver. New Orleans went 26-56 overall, 17-34 in Western Conference play and 17-24 at home during the 2025-26 season. The Pelicans allowed opponents to score 120.0 points per game and shoot 47.7% from the field last season. Denver went 54-28 overall and 36-16 in Western Conference games during the 2025-26 season. The Nuggets averaged 14.0 points off of turnovers, 14.7 second-chance points and 35.7 bench points last season. The teams square off for the third time this season. The Nuggets won the last meeting 104-91 on Oct. 29. Jamal Murray scored 23 points to help lead the Nuggets to the victory. INJURIES: Pelicans: Bryce McGowens: day to day (elbow), Yves Missi: day to day (knee), Dejounte Murray: day to day (ankle), Trendon Watford: day to day (ankle), Trey Murphy III: day to day (knee). Nuggets: Julian Strawther: out (knee). ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
